description_en: Removes an endpoint from a security group by calling the DetachSecurityGroupFromVpcEndpoint operation
description_zh: 调用DetachSecurityGroupFromVpcEndpoint接口，将终端节点移除安全组
kebab_example: aliyun privatelink detach-security-group-from-vpc-endpoint --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --security-group-id sg-hp3c8qj1tyct90ej0000 --endpoint-id ep-hp33b2e43fays7s80000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetachSecurityGroupFromVpcEndpoint

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the endpoint that you want to remove from the security group. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 要移除安全组的终端节点所属的地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the security group from which you want to remove the endpoint
parameters.name: security_group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint that you want to remove from the security group
parameters.help_zh: 要移除安全组的终端节点的ID
parameters.name: endpoint_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run without actually removing the endpoint from the security group. The system checks the required parameters, request syntax, and business restrictions. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check passes, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and sends the request. If the check passes, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会将终端节点移除安全组。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token
